reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is to present account-financial telemetry for DeepSeek users inside the DSH web interface by fetching balance/usage data and estimating session cost. It is best classified under external-services because its core behavior is calling external account and pricing services and surfacing that result to users, with auxiliary utility behavior in the UI display.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH Web GUI 中显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前会话预计花费，并可展示按费用类型和币种的分项，用于快速查看账户使用成本。
summaries.en: This plugin shows DeepSeek account balance and estimated current-session cost in the DSH web interface, including breakdown views for balance and token-cost buckets.

capabilities: Reads DeepSeek account balance via official API endpoint
Fetches official pricing data on a refresh schedule
Computes session cost estimates from token usage buckets
Displays balance and cost in DSH web composer dock UI
Reads API key from configured credential reference

reasons.code: The README states the plugin queries the official Get User Balance endpoint and official pricing page, then shows remaining balance and spend in the UI.
Configuration references DEEPSEEK_API_KEY via DSH credentials seam, indicating dependence on stored API credentials.
Package metadata marks this as a DSH web plugin with client/UI runtime dependencies and web platform injection, confirming integration into the running web interface.
